evidence.section: The Dwarf Kingdoms / Old Dwarf Road trade-house description
evidence.quote: Karaz Ankor Inn and Trade House
evidence.claim: A named Dwarf trading establishment is attested. Its proprietor, hereditary rights, warehouse and name must not be copied to generated businesses.

evidence.quote: Craft guilds also do not regulate prices or output.
evidence.claim: Dwarf craft associations exist, but the generated label cannot invent a guild monopoly, recognition or privileges.

evidence.quote: Every craftsguild depends on Merchant kin to sell their wares
evidence.claim: Dwarf trade, shopworkers and crafts are explicit. Craft and record emblems are Forthammer symbolic compositions, not proof of a company trade or clientele.

evidence.quote: Most Dwarf words have several meanings.
evidence.claim: Use only the recorded component sense; a new compound is not a certified canonical grammatical translation.

evidence.quote: All guilds follow the path of apprentice, journeyman and master
evidence.claim: Guild hierarchy is corroborated. No generated business label awards a rank or supplies a genealogy.

evidence.quote: Agrul Stone carving; lines in face of very old Dwarf
evidence.claim: Select stone carving as a sign image, not age or an ancestral face. The same page attests Duraz as stone or slab, Azul as metal of any kind and Bar as a fortified gateway or door.

evidence.quote: Galaz Gold of particular ornamental value
evidence.claim: Ornamental gold can describe a symbolic sign image without asserting company wealth. Grungron on this page supplies forge imagery, without establishing that a company operates a forge.

Urbar plus Kron uses trade and record as a commercial-record emblem. It supplies no transaction, ledger contents, clientele or trade route. Wutroth on this page supplies the precise material sense: wood from ancient mountain oak.

evidence.quote: simple texts used in day to day trading
evidence.claim: Written material in Dwarf daily trade is attested. A trade-record sign is an adaptation of that context, not a canonical company name or a fabricated account of past business.
Silver and bread are attested independent concepts, not invented product or wealth claims.
The selected moonlight sense and the printed material, shadow, work and sunrise nouns add distinct concepts. No generic machine, dawn-direction, geology or ancestry meaning is invented.

The conjunction explicitly pairs two reviewed images. Thrag means wound, Thrynaz includes laws, Tiwaz includes rest and Skaud includes song. These are not new translations for hospital, government or tavern.

High-resolution printed text confirms Zunthrum with n. Spear, money, sunset, remembering and gift are independently attested; none assigns actual stock, wealth, a historical event or a commemorated person.
